title: The Entire History of Ethiopia
brief: Make a clear, absorbing nine-minute story from Aksum to the November 2022 Pretoria agreement. Start with Italy expecting conquest at Adwa; make the reversal understandable before unfamiliar names. Follow rulers' choices, rivalries and consequences for people. Keep original understated wit, varied conversational rhythm, and sober treatment of suffering. Prefer real, relevant moving footage and whole images, minimal dates, no animation. Research all story beats deeply.
purpose: Screen all remaining candidates beyond the first 200 using bounded Gemini metadata batches, then inspect acquired video quality
